Author: Null
Name: Chocobo Color Calculator
Punchline: Plan and track an accurate chocobo color feeding route in game.
Description: Calculates and tracks ordered fruit routes between companion chocobo colors.
Changelog: Refined PDF, text, and HTML exports as clean static route guides by removing saved status labels, progress snapshots, and current-step highlighting. Every exported checklist now focuses only on step order, fruit, channel effect, and resulting RGB values; live progress tracking remains inside the plugin.
